name: pi-managed-vendor
description: Vendor bundle for engineering-agents Pi managed packages. Built by nix/modules/pi (npm ci from package-lock.json), combined with fetchFromGitHub-pinned git packages, and compiled into local facades at build time. Maintained by nix/modules/pi/config.nix — do not add ad-hoc dependencies here.
note-git-package-dependencies: Git-sourced managed packages (fetched by Nix, not npm) ship without their own node_modules. Their registry dependencies that pi does NOT inject are declared here: jiti + yaml + acorn (pi-subagents; acorn parses workflowScript), shell-quote + vscode-languageserver-protocol (pi-hooks), pi-taskflow + @benvargas/pi-claude-code-use + @sting8k/pi-vcc + @tintinweb/pi-tasks (pi-ext), @richardgill/pi-config (pi-preset peer). pi's injected core (@earendil-works/*, legacy @mariozechner/* aliases, typebox) is deliberately NOT vendored.
